text: Pass a glass of water over these three points of your body before bed. Let it absorb everything you are carrying. This is one of the oldest cleansing practices that exist. Fill a clear glass with clean water and hold it with both hands.

Say quietly: absorb everything I carry that does not belong to me. Now pass it slowly over your forehead, without touching the skin. The forehead is where the mental weight builds. The decisions you never make. Then pass it over your chest.

The chest holds everything you feel but never say. The sadness you swallow. The worry you pretend is not there. And finally, over your belly, in slow circles. The belly is where the body keeps fear. Then place the glass on your nightstand and sleep.

In the morning, look at it. Never drink it. Do not be afraid of what you find, my friend. Be afraid of how long you carried it without noticing. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
